body.name: bounded-TV fixed-schedule family
body.construction: \(\mathcal Y_{M,\gamma}=\{(Y_{bi}(z))_{(b,i)\in\mathcal T,z\in A_b}: |Y_{bi}(z)|\le M\text{ and }\sum_{b=1}^{B-1}|\mu_{b+1}-\mu_b|\le\gamma\}\) for every \(0\le\gamma\le\Gamma_{\mathrm{vac}}\), with \(\mathcal Y_{M,\Gamma}\) the target class.
